resolutions.researcher_notes: Same PNGRB 13-Dec-2010 authorization letter as the Fuel unit. Subject line: authorization 'for laying, building, operating or expanding Agartala regional natural gas pipeline network as COMMON CARRIER pipeline network under regulation 17(1) of the ... (Authorizing Entities to Lay, Build, Operate or Expand Natural Gas pipelines) Regulations, 2008'. Body: 'The Board has decided to declare the Agartala regional natural gas pipeline network as common carrier with common carrier capacity of 0.50 MMSCMD ... in terms of the PNGRB (Guiding Principles for Declaring or Authorizing Natural Gas Pipeline as Common Carrier or Contract Carrier) Regulations, 2009.' Under India's PNGRB regulatory framework, a 'common carrier' natural gas pipeline authorized under the trunk-pipeline (Authorizing Entities to Lay/Build/Operate natural gas pipelines) regulations is the transmission-network category, distinct from the separate City or Local (CGD) natural gas distribution-network authorization track that PNGRB regulates under different regulations -- so this authorization type itself supports PipelineType=transmission. Single-origin (PNGRB) so tier medium. Value UNCHANGED; ref-only addition.

resolutions.researcher_notes: TWO organizationally-independent sources triangulate on the same named gas fields. (1) PNGRB's 2010 authorization letter, Annexure-1 (page 4, 'REGION: AGARTALA'), names the network's own segments as 'KONABAN GGS TO KONABAN TAP-OFF', 'KONABAN TAP-OFF TO ANAND NAGAR', 'DOME TO ANADNAGAR', 'ANANDNAGAR TO NEEPCO' and 'KONABAN - ROKHIA P/L' -- i.e. the Agartala Regional Network's own gas gathering station (Konaban GGS) and one leg is literally named for the Rokhia gas field. (2) An unrelated-origin document, the Asian Development Bank's Environmental Impact Assessment for the Rokhia 120 MW Combined-Cycle Gas Power Project (sourced from Tripura Power Generation Ltd's own DPR, an entirely different chain of custody from PNGRB/GAIL), states: 'Natural gas is supplied through an existing gas pipeline of Konaban Gas Field of Gas Authority of India Ltd (GAIL) and Rokhia Gas Field of Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC)' and 'the Konaban gas field terminal of GAIL is around 8 km NW from the existing plant' in West Tripura district near Agartala. CAVEAT: the ADB document describes GAIL's Konaban-field infrastructure feeding the Rokhia Thermal Power Station specifically (a nearby, related consumer), not the Agartala Regional Gas Network by that exact name -- so it corroborates the underlying fact (GAIL's Tripura gas-network source is the Konaban/Rokhia gas-field complex) rather than citing this precise pipeline row. Given that independent cross-naming of the identical field names (Konaban, Rokhia) by two unrelated organizations, this is treated as tier high / independent=true for the general FuelSource claim 'Tripura Gas Field', while flagging the caveat rather than overclaiming a direct one-to-one citation. Value UNCHANGED; ref-only addition.
